findings: All 2048 measured rounds converged and drained, but the offered load was not sustained. This is overload evidence, not a supported operating point.

A separate local AOT deployment smoke check overlapped 9.387 seconds of this case's exercise on the client machine. It did not modify the Cloud server or database. Keep this overlap visible and do not use this case for an isolated performance-gain claim.

During the full exercise, the largest worker mean event-loop lag was 44.545 microseconds, the largest worker p95 upper bound was 107 microseconds and the largest observed lag was 4313 microseconds. Worker average CPU was at most 0.104 cores. These observations do not establish that the overlapping smoke had zero effect.

The lower 256-device repetition also fell behind, and its entire run started after the smoke check ended. The supported short-screen selection remains 128 devices; this overlapped 512-device trial is not needed to select that point.
